description: The brain: a curated, bounded model of the host model kept from what every released change produced. After a release a script collects the signals (the spec, the coder's notes, the verification, the health before and after) and the model map; a curator (a one-shot model call, or a headless agent in curate mode, chosen by the charter) answers a contract: facts to add and retire, the plan, decisions to propose, questions for the person; a script applies it deterministically and starts the next iteration. Every brief reads the brain.

places.p-steward-curations: Curation archive (every curation as answered, kept)
places.p-steward-knowledge: Knowledge facts: kind, scope, source, confidence, active or retired
places.p-steward-plan: The plan: remaining increments toward the goal
places.p-steward-adr: Decision records (the brain proposes, the person decides)

transitions.label: Observe: signals of a released run
Curate (headless agent, may read the pack repository)
A person's answer to a brain question
Apply: knowledge, plan, proposed decisions, questions, next iteration
